about: Corpus record for the dead-code confident tier, read by devmap-cli/tests/dead_tier_eligibility.rs. Each corpus is a `git archive` of the named commit, built with the binary named in `built_from`; every corpus built is listed, with every language it holds dead candidates or exempt symbols of — a language with rows: 0 was measured and had no confident-branch row; `rows` are the dead rows whose evidence reached the confident branch (published at 0.9, coverage-capped below it, or capped with confident_tier_unproven), each labelled from source by `rg -uu -w` and reading: dead_true (nothing reaches it), dead_false (a path:line reaches it), unsure (excluded from `rows`, listed). A listed language must have false_positive*20 <= rows on every corpus.
built_from: devmap 0.2.4 (store schema 27, code graph schema 2, build 2b8762cca6dc) — a clean release build of commit 2b8762cc, the commit before the one that last wrote this file (no code changed between them)
